scope: single Creality K2 Pro CFS; cfs0_050_G32 / cfs0_000_153
release: v3.19 volatile RAM bench, experimental not production

individual_advanced_set_get_reset.status: each transient override restored to default

host_guard_rejections.scope: Kalico host, not direct MCU out-of-range protocol tests

physical_mcu_rail_power_cycle.mechanism: T113 k2oh-ctl-managed MCU GPIO rail physical power OFF (2 seconds) then ON, followed by Klipper firmware restart; CM5 and T113 remained powered
startup_caveats: Initial CFS auto-probe timed out; a subsequent read-only CONFIG_INFO returned correctly.
Motor control discovery failed on the first attempt and succeeded on the second attempt.
Transient serial/RS485 timeouts occurred during boot; no remaining runtime CFS error after recovery.

note: One transient RS-485 timeout occurred during controller discovery after Klipper restart; startup recovered, motor-control completed and follow-up communications succeeded.
unvalidated: real CFS filament load/unload motor behaviour under physical load
RFID spool movement and motion-hook implementation (v3.19 does not enable advanced hooks)
direct MCU range-rejection bypassing host validation
long-term physical MCU cycling reliability, including serial/motor startup retries observed on the first tested power cycle
safety: Use v3.13 for known-good rollback; v3.19 remains experimental.
